_README: Labelled duplicate clusters for Rumour Guard (D05, source S15: 'Gets its own labelled test set of known-duplicate clusters'). Scored by backend/scripts/eval_dedup.py, which sweeps the similarity threshold and reports precision/recall so DEDUP_SIMILARITY_THRESHOLD is chosen from evidence rather than taste. HONEST LIMIT: these summaries are hand-written in the style the extraction model produces (short, English, one event per line) rather than captured from real runs, because live ingestion has produced one flag so far. Replace them with real extracted_incidents.summary_en values as the corpus grows -- that is strictly better and the format is identical.
notes_on_construction: Each cluster is one real-world event as several outlets would describe it. `hard_negatives` are the pairs that actually reach the embedding test: same kind, same neighbourhood, same 6-hour window, different event. Pairs that differ in kind or sit kilometres apart are excluded by the SQL gates before any embedding happens, so scoring them here would flatter the threshold.
